paper.title_en: Entanglement entropy in topological tensor networks
paper.abstract_en: We derive an entropy formula for recently proposed tensor network models which prepare diffeomorphism invariant states of topological quantum field theories with non-compact and/or continuous gauge groups. We show that our entropy formula generalizes the notion of ``topological entanglement entropy'' to incorporate the infinite number of particle-like excitations in such theories. When our networks are endowed with gauge group $\mathrm{SL}(2,\mathbb{R})$, we can interpret them as models of three-dimensional gravity with small Newton's constant and possibly non-invertible metrics.
